title: Requesting a day off
objectives: Request a specific day off and give a brief reason
Explain how you will cover the urgent work
Confirm any handover before you leave

courseTemplate.setting: The learner needs Friday off and can finish the research slide deck by Thursday.

roles.learner: An employee with a visa appointment

courseTemplate.openingLine: Sure, I've got a minute. What's up?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I take Friday off? I have a visa appointment that morning.
targetPatterns.example: Could I take Friday off? I have a visa appointment that morning.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll finish the user research deck by Thursday afternoon.
targetPatterns.example: I'll finish the user research deck by Thursday afternoon.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll send Sam the latest version and ask them to cover any questions.
targetPatterns.example: I'll send Sam the latest version and ask them to cover any questions.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll be out of office tomorrow for a medical appointment.
targetPatterns.example: I'll be out of office tomorrow for a medical appointment.

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you cover for me on Thursday?
targetPatterns.example: Could you cover for me on Thursday?

targetPatterns.pattern: I submitted the expense report — could you approve it?
targetPatterns.example: I submitted the expense report — could you approve it?
targetPatterns.translation: 我提交了报销单，能帮我批一下吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Sorry to bug you, but this is time-sensitive.
targetPatterns.example: Sorry to bug you, but this is time-sensitive.
targetPatterns.translation: 不好意思打扰，这事比较急。

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm running a bit behind — I'll send it by 3.
targetPatterns.example: I'm running a bit behind — I'll send it by 3.
targetPatterns.translation: 我进度有点落后，3 点前发你。

targetPatterns.pattern: Feel free to ping me anytime.
targetPatterns.example: Feel free to ping me anytime.

stages.title: Request a specific day off and give a brief reason
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Sure, I've got a minute. What's up?”
successCriteria: The learner can request a specific day off and give a brief reason in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Could I take Friday …”

stages.title: Explain how you will cover the urgent work
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “That should be fine. Is there anything urgent on your plate?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain how you will cover the urgent work in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'll finish the user …”

stages.title: Confirm any handover before you leave
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Great. Can anyone answer questions about the deck on Friday?”
successCriteria: The learner can confirm any handover before you leave in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'll send Sam the …”

languageNotes: 请假说 take a day off，不是 "have a rest"；「有点忙」说 I'm swamped / tied up，不说 "my job is very busy"。
